whenToUse: Password-free sign-in with a passkey ceremony and clear waiting, cancelled and done states.
Listing, adding, renaming and removing the account's passkeys.
avoidWhen: Classic email and password sign-in — use login-01.
Full security overview with devices and history — use settings-07.
a11y: Ceremony state changes are announced through aria-live regions.
Toggle controls expose aria-pressed and the add-passkey flow runs in a titled dialog.
